page.overview:
Who is Nick Stickers?

"Nicks secret passion has always been bumper stickers. Fearing the looks he might get from his friends and co-workers, Nick's never actually worn the bumper stickers; he just buys them and hides them in his trunk. Then one day, he stumbled upon Lizzie's Curio Shop.

Her bumper stickers were so hilarious; Nick decided it was time to let it all hang out. "

entity.description: "Nicks secret passion has always been bumper stickers. Fearing the looks he might get from his friends and co-workers, Nick's never actually worn the bumper stickers; he just buys them and hides them in his trunk. Then one day, he stumbled upon Lizzie's Curio Shop. Her bumper stickers were so hilarious; Nick decided it was time to let it all hang out. Now, Nick drives down the road covered bumper to bumper in stickers, and he's never felt so free."
